description: Targeted Lanczos eigval computation of the symmetric part of ρ_λ(T_w_⁶Li) for λ = (6,6,6) and (3,3,3,3,3,3) — the predicted dominant pair under the rectangular-form conjecture at A=6. Bypasses the d_λ=87,516 dense-matrix infeasibility of the full Rust solver by using a LinearOperator wrapper that applies the 71-crossing braid chain on-the-fly via sparse mat-vec.

[6, 6, 6].error: no supported conversion for types: (dtype('float64'), dtype('O'))

[3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3].error: no supported conversion for types: (dtype('float64'), dtype('O'))

lean_uniqueness_ref.note: T_w uniqueness at the abstract empty-constraint SDP level (PR #1537/#1542 parameterised module). Workplan: docs/workplans/2026-05-31-witness-lean-uniqueness-ref-wiring.md.

caveats: Lanczos tolerance 1e-6; for d_λ=87,516 this gives ~6 digits of agreement with exact dense-LAPACK eigvals. The braid action is applied on-the-fly so the d×d dense matrix is never materialised; this is the only way to get to (6,6,6) at the current Rust solver's compute budget.
